label: D2 reaching S2 after a rewarded previous trial, late in episode (trial >= 80)
explanation: Fires only at D2 and only when the state shown is S2. It needs the previous trial to have been rewarded (reward input at this trial D1 = 1) and appears only late in the episode: none before trial 50, and 69% of activation mass in trials 90-99. Rate also rises with low model value (70% of mass in the lowest value bin). All variables are observable at D2. The base condition D2 & S2 & prev_reward==1 covers all activations, but precision is only 4%. Adding ep_trial>=80 gives dev precision 0.17, recall 0.87, mass recall 0.93. Magnitude is largest when the agent switches from a1 to a2 after a rare-rewarded trial (a1 to S2 rewarded, then a2 to S2 common). The top examples are all of this kind, and adding stay==0 raises precision to 0.75 but keeps only 56% of the mass. It never fires at D1 or GO, at S1, or after an unrewarded trial. Within the predicate it is silent on most late S2-after-reward steps, so the description is incomplete. It may encode a late-episode or low-value signal in its magnitude.
